svg.title: Atmospheric scoop orbit and operating cycle
svg.desc: Earth and the 100 by 2000 kilometre scoop orbit at equal scale, with a circular delivery orbit, an enlarged atmospheric pass and a time-proportional cycle strip. The open-mouth comparison cycle has a 106.2 minute period.
